title: pilosella aurantiaca subsp. porphyromelana
intro: Pilosella aurantiaca subsp. porphyromelana, commonly known as Orange Hawk's Beard, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating digestive issues, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella aurantiaca subsp. porphyromelana may also contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine for its antiseptic and antipruritic properties.
